# k3d_cluster (Data Source)

Reads an existing k3d cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "k3d_cluster" "main" {
  name = "demo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Cluster name.

### Read-Only

- `agents` (Number) Number of agent nodes.
- `api` (Attributes) How the Kubernetes API is exposed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api))
- `client_certificate` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded client certificate.
- `client_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded client key.
- `cluster_ca_certificate` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded cluster CA certificate.
- `host` (String) Kubernetes API URL.
- `id` (String) The cluster name.
- `image` (String) k3s image of the server nodes.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig for the cluster.
- `network` (String) Docker network of the cluster.
- `ports` (Attributes Set) Host ports mapped through the cluster load balancer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))
- `servers` (Number) Number of server nodes.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Cluster join token.

<a id="nestedatt--api"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api`

Read-Only:

- `host` (String) Host name used in the kubeconfig.
- `host_ip` (String) Host IP the API listens on.
- `port` (Number) Host port the API listens on.


<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Read-Only:

- `container_port` (Number) Port on the nodes.
- `host_ip` (String) Host IP, null for all interfaces.
- `host_port` (Number) Port on the Docker host.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol, null for tcp.
